visual_style: Vertical 9:16, warm natural daylight, gentle realistic cinematic look. A Pakistani government school: whitewashed walls, a plain green blackboard with no writing, wooden desks, pupils in school uniform. Modest dress. No on-screen text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks anywhere in the frame. Nobody speaks to the camera; the narration is a voice-over.

narrator.name: off-screen narrator
narrator.description: An unseen Pakistani woman teacher in her thirties, warm, clear and confident; voice-over only, never shown on camera.

shots.visual: A teacher in a Pakistani school computer lab looks puzzled at a frozen desktop computer while pupils at nearby machines turn to watch; all screens softly blurred.
Close-up of hands opening a desktop computer case on a table, showing the motherboard, memory sticks and cables, then the camera pulls back to curious student teachers.
A student teacher at a laptop thoughtfully covers a password field with her hand while a classmate looks away politely; screen blurred and unreadable.
A small group of student teachers around one laptop in a school library, pointing and discussing; screen softly blurred.

In a sunlit school corridor, a young woman trainee teacher holds a phone and scrolls a textbook page (screen blurred, unreadable), then looks up with a confident smile as pupils walk past softly in the background.

narration: کمپیوٹر ہر جگہ ہے، مگر کیا آپ واقعی اسے سمجھتے ہیں؟ ایک استاد کے لیے یہ ضروری کیوں ہے؟
آپ computer literacy، hardware اور software، اور operating system کے بنیادی تصورات سیکھیں گے۔
آپ cyber security، passwords، digital footprint اور ICT کا ethical استعمال سیکھیں گے، plagiarism سے بچنا بھی۔
چھ units، internet tools سے artificial intelligence تک، تاکہ آپ کی تدریس آج کی ٹیکنالوجی کے ساتھ چلے۔
پورا کورس مفت پڑھیں textbook ڈاٹ کام ڈاٹ پی کے پر۔ لنک نیچے ہے۔
